rows.progress: One versioned principles file feeds the controlled context and generated pipeline consumer. The dispatch inventory exercises conflicting instructions and rejects missing principles.
rows.gaps: Live adherence and qualified professional evaluation remain open. Loading principles does not prove model compliance.

rows.progress: Provider-neutral tool messages and strict argument schemas are implemented in OpenAI, Anthropic, scripted and replay adapters, with policy and trace wrappers. Actual returned provider/model/tier is checked before tool execution.
rows.gaps: Live provider interoperability and semantic model quality remain unqualified. Anthropic is not enabled for client processing by these changes.

rows.progress: The controlled caller runs model-selected tools with saved starts, whole-task time/token/cost boundaries, cancellation and content-based stagnation. Exact finished retry is free; unknown interrupted external work is not repeated.
rows.gaps: The loop is recorded/synthetic only. Normal chat cutover, complete tool catalogue, shared final publication subjects and live golden comparisons remain open.

rows.progress: Exact final claim packages bind retrieved locators, source windows and current file premises to the sealed work journal. Changed quotes, foreign facts and unsaved package replacements are rejected.
rows.gaps: This is private candidate preparation and review, not the complete client publication contract. Unconfirmed assertions are not established premises; calibrated independent judgments remain open.

rows.progress: The existing output policies have one callable owner producing all eighteen named check receipts. The pipeline delegates to shared owners. Absent subjects are explicitly unassessed.
rows.gaps: All actual post-loop publication subjects, bounded repair and full final-byte delivery are not yet established. Eighteen function receipts alone are not an all-pass release.

rows.progress: Six shared professional boundary receipts preserve current screen, capacity, authority, scope and duty states. Tool authority derives from each declared operation, and both checks run around the actual handler.
rows.gaps: Complete independent duty and professional boundary assessment for controlled publication and qualified review remain open. An unknown or stale clearance cannot become permission.

rows.progress: A different pinned model independently reviews exact final paragraphs using separate support, applicability, inference and opposition judgments. Unknown verification withholds affected packages and dependent claims. Reviews are saved and share the parent resource budget.
rows.gaps: Qualified labels, agreement thresholds, both classification error directions and live different-model approval/evaluation remain open. No semantic or professional acceptance is claimed.

rows.progress: Immutable tool definitions, kind-specific source/matter/computation/control receipts and checks before/after invocation are implemented. Contract drift cannot execute or return unadmitted work. Prepared writes commit with their receipt in one sealed transaction.
rows.gaps: This population covers implemented tools, not the entire planned catalogue. External actions and absent capability owners remain unavailable.

rows.progress: Replay consumes captured requests, versions, model identity, results and failures from the actual sealed loop. Changed requests or interrupted outcomes are refused without repeating external work.
rows.gaps: Live comparative quality, full same-matter paired evaluations, completion-rate measurement and cutover evidence remain open.

rows.progress: The controlled session pins the principles/tool prefix and appends provider-neutral history without rewriting earlier request bytes. Independent uncertainty dimensions remain separate.
rows.gaps: This does not prove live cache performance or semantic adherence. Normal pipeline reads and client cutover retain their existing contracts.

rows.progress: Compaction rebuilds from the current checked file, retains correction/conflict provenance and explicitly refuses material that cannot fit. Unsupported handover prose cannot replace the file. Recovery verifies exact saved scope and source identity.
rows.gaps: Automatic whole-loop compaction under large live matters and independently verified semantic summaries are not established. Context refusal is not completed analysis.

rows.progress: Typed loop stages are saved in the sealed matter and exposed through owned, resumable progress reads. A controlled browser journey verifies History, reopen and logout. Raw prompts, private deliberation and unreleased advice are excluded.
rows.gaps: Full per-turn/per-dispute working display, checked source explanations and final answer streaming remain open. Controlled browser checks are not a live-model quality run.
